presentation.body: Skrzynka can start from a mailbox you already use. It resolves the account through a Skarbiec item reference, so secret values never move into command arguments, API payloads, or the desktop app.
presentation.title: Start with your existing inbox

presentation.body: Run `skrzynka mailbox import --skarbiec-item <ITEM_ID>`. Skrzynka validates the saved profile, authenticates to IMAP, fetches and normalizes one page of INBOX, then commits the mailbox, accepted messages, and UID cursor in one SQLite transaction. Repeat while `has_more` is true.
presentation.title: Connect and import atomically

presentation.body: A successful import that persists at least one real message records first success. Invalid credentials and profile conflicts leave no new mailbox or message page. The result reports imported, unchanged, conflicting, and rejected counts without printing credential or message content. Run `skrzynka onboarding` again after the import to finish.
